description: Read the latest beam: every screenshot the user sent to this host with Hostbeam in one gesture (several, if they beamed several), with how long ago it arrived. Use this when they refer to a screenshot, to something being broken on screen, or ask you to look at what they are seeing. If it does not match what they describe, or arrived long before they asked, say so rather than assuming it is what they meant.
name: latest_screenshot
title: Latest screenshot
